description: Cross-device behavioural rules that hold regardless of device type. Contains no per-device traffic magnitudes, so it can seed an unknown asset without borrowing another device's statistics.

derivation.notes: Destination categories and forbidden patterns are shared across IoMT classes. Rate/duration magnitudes are deliberately excluded because they differ by orders of magnitude between device types.

guardrails.notes: Until a learned baseline exists, only forbidden-pattern violations may alert. Absence of a rate baseline must not be treated as an anomaly.
